defs.def: a well-known phrase or statement that expresses sth about life that most people believe is wise and true 谚语；格言；警句

ex.s: While going through the pages, he kept saying, wide-eyed: “How can there be this many words?” After a while, he looked at me and asked, “Do you know all these words, Mom?” I smiled, “I definitely do not know all these words,” I said.
ex.t: 他翻着书页，睁大眼睛不停地说：“怎么会有这么多词？”过了一会儿，他看着我问：“妈妈，你认识所有这些词吗？”我笑着说：“我确实不认识所有这些词。”

ex.s: Importantly, Chesterton is not saying that things can never be reformed.
ex.t: 我们可以这样重新表述：在否定过去的决策之前，先理解其中蕴含的智慧。

ex.s: “Sometimes I don’t like saying that I’m a teacher,” says Ho.
ex.t: “有时候我不喜欢说自己是老师，”何老师说。

ex.s: But one day when I heard her saying “I think I’m too fat,” my heart sank.
ex.t: 但有一天，当我听到她说“我觉得自己太胖了”时，我的心一沉。

ex.s: According to Charlotte Markey, a professor of psychology, food is one of the rare subjects where, as parents, saying less is more.
ex.t: 据心理学教授Charlotte Markey所说，食物是少数几个话题之一，在这些话题上，作为父母，少说比多说更好。

ex.s: You should feel satisfied at the end of a meal, but not too full. ____16____ But it doesn't mean saying goodbye to the foods you love.
ex.t: 一顿饭结束时你应感到满足，但别吃太撑。____16____ 但这并不意味着要和喜欢的食物说再见。

ex.s: She put the new color on her hair or sat still for 30 minutes, just as the directions saying.
ex.t: 她把染发剂涂在头发上，然后静坐了30分钟，就像说明书上写的那样。

ex.s: Simply saying thank you doesn't seem enough in certain situations.
ex.t: 简单地说,在某些情况下,谢谢你似乎还不够。

ex.t: 所以想想他发邮件说想来看望我时，我该有多么惊讶吧。

ex.s: He was just saying: “I’m king of this forest, and here is your reminder!” Once his message was delivered, he allowed me    70    (stay) and watch.
ex.t: 它只是在说："我是这片森林之王，这是提醒你！"一旦传达完信息，它允许我____70____（stay）留下观察。

ex.s: He was impressed, saying “.... all the soldiers ___36___ themselves to one idea and worked together to put that idea over.” He then began using the term gung-ho in the Marine Corps to try to create the same spirit he had ___37___.
ex.t: 他印象深刻,说“......所有士兵____36____自己都认同一个想法,并共同努力将这一想法付诸东流。” 然后,他开始使用海军陆战队中的gung-ho一词,试图创造出他拥有的同样____37____精神。

ex.t: （注："打包袋"是一种袋子或盒子，用来把餐厅没吃完的食物带回家。）你在超市看到一个牌子写着"3件2元"。
